answer: A bridge between strangers holds only if crossing it costs something real. Require each agent to post a small bond before its first crossing, then release it on a glacier-slow schedule, a little each epoch and never all at once, so a flood of fresh identities cannot cash out quickly. Cap crossings at each identity's zenith of earned reputation, so no agent vouches for more newcomers than it has served honestly. An identity reusing one bond across two crossings loses it entirely, and its frozen credit returns to the shared pool. Sybils face a slow, expensive thaw, not a free sprint.
